evals.prompt: We are redesigning first-run onboarding for a collaborative AI workspace. Use this browser receipt from today's research: Mobbin https://mobbin.com/browse/web/apps redirected to its marketing/login surface, so deeper flow access was unavailable; Page Flows https://pageflows.com/web/flows/ exposed onboarding and invite categories; its public HeyGen onboarding flow https://pageflows.com/post/desktop-web/onboarding/heygen/ showed Home, Sign up, Enter code, Pricing, Get started, Add prompt, Submit, Generating answer, Loading, Generated AI, Download, Onboarding tasks, Create video, and return Home. Evidence files: tickets/TASK-9004/artifacts/mobbin-public-flows.png, tickets/TASK-9004/artifacts/pageflows-web-flows-index.png, and tickets/TASK-9004/artifacts/pageflows-heygen-direct.png. Recommend a proven interaction model rather than an invented wizard and preserve the evidence decisions.
evals.expected_output: Validates and reuses the supplied current browser receipt rather than rerunning it; Captures source URLs, job, sequence, states, access limits, evidence refs, and adopt/adapt/reject decisions; Uses Page Flows workflow evidence and treats Mobbin as an access-limited source; Uses functional sources rather than taste galleries; Recommends a concrete state-complete workflow
assertions: Validates and reuses the supplied current browser-operation receipt instead of redundantly rerunning the same sources.
Records source URL, user job/query, observed sequence and states, access/login limits, evidence refs, and adopt/adapt/reject decisions.
Treats Mobbin as an access-limited source and Page Flows/HeyGen as operated journey and sequence evidence.
Does not use Pinterest, galleries, or isolated aesthetic screenshots as functional workflow proof.
Recommends one concrete onboarding model with empty, loading, failure, recovery, success, and return states.

Defines disabled, saving, success, and error behavior for the button.

evals.prompt: A support lead needs to triage an incoming incident, assign an owner, request missing evidence, and resolve or reopen it. The team has no accepted interaction model. Produce only the functional planning handoff for impl-plan; visual style and assets are not in scope.
evals.expected_output: Defines the user job and complete state model; researches or clearly scopes operated comparable evidence; provides a compact ASCII wireflow because the state transition is material; hands interaction decisions to impl-plan without inventing visual direction, assets, a component library, or a child implementation plan.
assertions: Defines triage, assignment, evidence request, resolve, reopen, empty, loading, error, and recovery states.
Uses or explicitly bounds comparable workflow evidence rather than aesthetic references as functional proof.
Includes a compact ASCII wireflow because the transition path is not obvious from prose alone.
Hands the accepted interaction model to impl-plan and does not become a frontend implementation router.
Does not invent visual direction, media requirements, or a component-library decision.

farplane.title: Functional UI returns an optional low-fi planning handoff

evals.prompt: An incident lead must assign each incoming production incident to an owner fast. The draft puts a recommendations carousel, an import wizard, a permanent activity feed, and a six-step setup before the incident queue. The actual workflow must still handle evidence requests, resolution, reopening, empty, loading, error, and recovery states. Recommend the functional planning handoff.
evals.expected_output: Names the operator benefit and one core assignment action; removes or defers unrelated choices while preserving necessary incident states and evidence; records an explicit rejected complexity; recommends a concrete workflow rather than a visual style imitation.
assertions: States the customer benefit and identifies assigning an incident owner as the core action.
Removes or defers the recommendations carousel, import wizard, permanent activity feed, or setup steps unless a user-job reason justifies them.
Names a deliberate no rather than merely calling the UI cleaner or simpler.
Preserves evidence requests, resolution, reopening, empty, loading, error, and recovery behavior.
Returns a concrete functional handoff without substituting visual style for workflow judgment.
